address: SP 62 n.24, località Curina, Castelnuovo Berardenga, 53019, Italy
bio: The cuisine is a tribute to Tuscan tradition, with some elegant detours, always guided by the rhythm of the seasons. While the main courses are dominated by an undisputed queen – the Fiorentina steak, regal and magnificent – the handmade pici with guanciale and pecorino are also a must-try. The sunset provides the perfect backdrop, making every dish even more memorable....
